import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws=wb.active
blocks={1:(2,5),2:(6,9),3:(10,13)}
for r in range(2,14):
    a=ws.cell(r,1).value
    s,e=blocks[a]
    ws.cell(r,4).value='=IF(B%d=MAX(\$B\$%d:\$B\$%d),B%d,\"\")'%(r,s,e,r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
